title: credential lease batcher and typed stream-sink ergonomics (Go SDK)
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Go SDK v1.9.0: introduce credential lease batcher, typed stream sink API, adaptive retry weights for streaming, backwards-compatible adapters. No breaking changes for callers using legacy callback streams. Performance and CPU improvements on auth-heavy workloads.
description: Context and motivation: Customers running long-lived streaming clients observed token churn when multiple concurrent streams re-auth at similar windows, and SDK ergonomics for stream sinks in Go lagged behind the typed async-iterable ergonomics in other SDKs. This PR implements a credential lease batcher to reduce reauth storming, introduces a typed StreamSink interface to improve ergonomics and type-safety, and adds an adaptive retry-weight profile specifically for streaming paths. Summary of changes and motivation: 1) credential/lease: new reauth.BatchScheduler and lease.Pool interfaces (concrete implementation BatchLeaser) that coalesce near-simultaneous credential refreshes into a single token fetch per host/region window, lowering QPS to auth backends. 2) streaming: add typed stream Sink and SinkAdapter to replace less-idiomatic callback sinks while providing a compatibility shim. The new Sink exposes Push(ctx, envelope) error and Close(ctx) error with context deadlines for graceful shutdowns. 3) retry: add RetryProfileStream which uses jitter-aware backoff weights and latency-aware retry ceilings (used by streaming RPCs). 4) telemetry: hooks for cred lease metrics and per-sink backpressure/backoff telemetry. 5) version bump: Go SDK to v1.9.0, update changelog and examples. Commits (high-level): - add batcher and lease pool with unit tests - introduce typed StreamSink, adapters and examples - implement RetryProfileStream and wire into streaming client - telemetry hooks and prometheus labels - docs and migration notes - unit + integration tests and bench harness Changes by area (files, high-level): - credential/lease/batcher.go added core batcher implementation - credential/lease/pool.go pool API and tests - streaming/sink.go new typed interface and adapter shim - streaming/sink_adapter_compat.go backward compatibility shim for callback codepaths - retry/profiles_stream.go new stream retry profile - examples/streaming/typed_sink_example.go example and migration guide - telemetry/metrics.go add cred lease metrics and labels - CHANGES.md and VERSION file bump - tests/integration/stream_lease_bench_test.go bench and CI integration notes Performance and benchmarks: synthetic auth-heavy integration bench ran on a 1000-concurrent-streams workload. Observed results: median token fetches to auth service reduced by ~78% under aligned refresh windows; end-to-end mean latency for stream connect+first-event improved 6-12% depending on region; per-worker CPU usage decreased ~18% in auth hotspots because fewer goroutines blocked on repeated reauth. Safety and compatibility: The typed Sink interface is additive. To prevent breaking callers we included SinkAdapter that wraps the legacy callback-based subscription sinks. We changed Stream.Close signature to return error (previously void) to allow callers to observe drain failures; a compatibility adapter retains the old behavior for callers that ignore the returned error. Testing: Added unit tests covering batch coalescing edge cases, race detector runs for lease pool, and integration bench that exercises reauth storms. CI: initial pipeline showed a flaky integration test in the bench harness (TestStreamLease_Race) failing under Go race detector on the first run. Fix committed to use a tighter sync fence and re-run. Final CI: all checks passed including linters, unit tests, integration bench (non-flaky on rerun), and benchmarks recorded as artifacts. Review conversation summary: - Amelia Ruiz requested clearer migration notes and an explicit adapter example for the legacy callback API. Author responded with an example in examples/streaming/typed_sink_example.go and updated CHANGES.md. - Jonah Kim asked for metrics labels to include "cred_scope" and a clarified histogram for reauth latency; author added labels and a synthetic histogram in telemetry/metrics.go. - Sofia Alvarez flagged potential deadlock in batcher shutdown; author added explicit shutdown sequence and added a deterministic unit test that reproduced and then fixed the issue. All reviewers approved after the follow-ups. Merge and release details: Merged via squash-and-merge into main on 2026-03-05. Release notes updated and an internal rollout plan scheduled for Dedicated clusters (ENG-2148) with a feature flag for batcher enabled off by default. Migration guidance: - Users can switch to the typed StreamSink for clearer error handling and context-aware Close. - If using legacy callback sinks, no immediate action required thanks to SinkAdapter, but switching recommended for observability and structured shutdowns. - To enable credential batching cluster-side, flip feature flag "cred.batch.enabled"; rollout staged in Dedicated and Private deployments. Related work: coordinated with SDK teams (PY/TS) to align retry profile names and metrics; a follow-up task ENG-2199 will add the same batcher shim to Python and TypeScript SDKs.
